attr.title: OMORI ReZig
attr.desc: Play OMORI using OMORI ReZig, a native Zig engine for user-supplied PC or Android game data. R36S port by José Pilas. Game by OMOCAT and team.
attr.inst: Extract OMORI-ReZig-0.0.1-R36S.zip into the Ports directory. Copy your Android APK or your complete PC installation into omori/original/ and launch OMORI ReZig. Existing installations use the same data and save paths. A confirms, B cancels, Start opens the field menu when the story permits, X runs, Y tags and Start + Select exits. See omori/README.md for controls, save recovery and the matching engine source.
reqs: OMORI Android APK or PC installation data (user-supplied)
